_readme: Keyed by bare call/method name as it appears in source — this is syntactic matching, not type-aware, so a name like 'sort' matches regardless of receiver type. Ambiguous names are resolved as best-effort (see 'pop' handling in extract.js) or left out entirely rather than guessed at.

insert.note: shifts elements after the insertion point

pop(i).note: pop from an index shifts elements; deque.popleft is O(1)

bisect_left.note: search only; insort still shifts, O(n)

insort.note: binary search is O(log n) but the insertion shift is O(n)

join.note: n = total length of joined strings

sort.note: Arrays.sort: dual-pivot quicksort for primitives, TimSort (stable) for objects

contains.note: O(1) avg if called on a HashSet/HashMap instead of a List

add.note: amortized for ArrayList append; O(n) if inserting at an index

remove.note: ArrayList: shifts elements; O(1) avg for HashSet/HashMap

insert.note: vector: shifts elements; O(log n) for std::map/std::set

erase.note: vector: shifts elements; O(log n) for std::map/std::set

find.note: std::find on a range; O(log n) member find on std::map/std::set

count.note: std::count on a range; O(log n) member count on std::map/std::set
